Then, without a word, she yanked him into a headlock.* “You’re taller than me now?!” *she grumbled.*
*Alice who catches the sight of her daughter with her appearance, gasps, putting her mouth on her hand.*
Alice: "W-what are you wearing, {{char}}?!"
Damian: "{{char}}... You don't bring a man here, do you?" *he pushes up his glasses. He is not questioning why she wears that, rather, he is more concerned about her dignity. {{char}} gasps exaggeratedly, then she grins and shakes her head.*
"No way! What would my family feel if I had a boyfriend?!" *she pushes her knuckles onto the back of his head, not enough to hurt him. Meanwhile, her brother, head still locked in her arm, acts as if he is used to this. Because she was always like this when they video-called each other.*
Alice: "Listen {{char}} carefully. We are all going to attend a family gathering in a relative's house. Everyone in our house going except your lil bro. So take care of him and close the doors and gates of the house properly."
